title: 隧道管片接頭結構驗證~Structural verification of segment joints
focus: 用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫~Check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior
summary: 本課聚焦用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 軸力彎矩與偏心~Axial force bending and eccentricity
units.title: 軸力彎矩與偏心~Axial force bending and eccentricity
units.mechanism: 接縫軸壓和彎矩共同決定接觸區，偏心增加會使一側壓力升高而另一側可能張開。把接縫當完整混凝土斷面會高估拉力傳遞，應先確定是否容許拉開及由哪些元件承擔拉力。 假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。 忽略偏心會低估局部壓碎，錯用完整斷面拉應力又會假設不存在的抗拉連續性；兩種誤用可能同時讓接縫看似剛硬且承載充足。~Compression and bending determine contact area. Increasing eccentricity raises pressure on one edge and may open the other. Treating the joint as monolithic concrete overstates tensile transfer unless the actual tension-carrying components are identified. Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry. Ignoring eccentricity understates local crushing, while monolithic tensile stress assumes nonexistent continuity. Together these mistakes can make a joint appear both stiffer and stronger than its actual contact permits.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry.
units.verify: 以一致正負號繪製接縫N-M工況，對照全接觸、局部接觸和張開模型；用接縫試驗或核准數值分析驗證接觸範圍，不能只用混凝土抗壓值判定接縫安全。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略偏心會低估局部壓碎，錯用完整斷面拉應力又會假設不存在的抗拉連續性；兩種誤用可能同時讓接縫看似剛硬且承載充足。~Plot joint N-M cases with consistent signs and compare full, partial and open-contact models; verify contact through tests or approved analysis rather than deciding joint adequacy from concrete compressive strength alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring eccentricity understates local crushing, while monolithic tensile stress assumes nonexistent continuity. Together these mistakes can make a joint appear both stiffer and stronger than its actual contact permits.
units.failure: 忽略偏心會低估局部壓碎，錯用完整斷面拉應力又會假設不存在的抗拉連續性；兩種誤用可能同時讓接縫看似剛硬且承載充足。~Ignoring eccentricity understates local crushing, while monolithic tensile stress assumes nonexistent continuity. Together these mistakes can make a joint appear both stiffer and stronger than its actual contact permits.
units.misconception: 接縫軸力不大時就不必考慮偏心彎矩與局部接觸。~Modest joint axial force eliminates the need to consider eccentric bending and local contact.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄軸力彎矩與偏心的資料來源與適用條件。以一致正負號繪製接縫N-M工況，對照全接觸、局部接觸和張開模型；用接縫試驗或核准數值分析驗證接觸範圍，不能只用混凝土抗壓值判定接縫安全。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for axial force bending and eccentricity. Plot joint N-M cases with consistent signs and compare full, partial and open-contact models; verify contact through tests or approved analysis rather than deciding joint adequacy from concrete compressive strength alone.

units.anchor: 接觸核心與張開~Contact kern and opening
units.title: 接觸核心與張開~Contact kern and opening
units.mechanism: 矩形接觸面在線性全壓條件下有核心範圍，偏心超出後會出現計算拉應力，表示全接觸假設需改變。這不是混凝土突然破壞，而是應轉成不承拉接觸及連接件共同作用模型。 假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。~A rectangular contact has a kern under linear compression. Beyond it, calculated tension signals loss of the full-contact assumption rather than immediate concrete failure, requiring no-tension contact and connector action to be modeled together. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold. Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold.
units.verify: 量測接觸面尺寸及平整度，以壓敏材料或位移計檢查受載後接觸分布；分析中逐步檢視張開位置與螺栓受力，將幾何不完美納入而非只檢查名義矩形。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。~Measure contact dimensions and flatness and observe loaded contact with appropriate film or gauges; track opening and bolt force in analysis, including imperfections rather than checking only a nominal rectangular surface. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first.
units.failure: 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。~Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first.
units.misconception: 偏心超出核心就表示混凝土已必然立即破壞。~Eccentricity outside the kern necessarily means immediate concrete failure has already occurred.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄接觸核心與張開的資料來源與適用條件。量測接觸面尺寸及平整度，以壓敏材料或位移計檢查受載後接觸分布；分析中逐步檢視張開位置與螺栓受力，將幾何不完美納入而非只檢查名義矩形。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for contact kern and opening. Measure contact dimensions and flatness and observe loaded contact with appropriate film or gauges; track opening and bolt force in analysis, including imperfections rather than checking only a nominal rectangular surface.

units.anchor: 螺栓預力與摩擦離散~Bolt preload and friction scatter
units.title: 螺栓預力與摩擦離散~Bolt preload and friction scatter
units.mechanism: 鎖付扭矩透過螺紋和支承摩擦轉成預力，摩擦差異會讓同扭矩產生不同拉力。預力維持接觸但也增加局部荷載，不能將扭矩值本身當成已驗證的螺栓受力。 假設示意T=KdF，K=0.2、d=0.024 m、F=100 kN，T=480 N·m；非現場鎖付規格。 摩擦偏大時扭矩達標但預力不足，偏小時又可能過度拉伸；若接縫後續鬆弛未被追蹤，初始合格紀錄也不能證明長期接觸狀態。~Tightening torque becomes preload through thread and bearing friction, so equal torque can produce different tension. Preload maintains contact while adding local loads, making torque alone insufficient evidence of actual bolt force. For assumed T=KdF with K=0.2, d=0.024 m and F=100 kN, T=480 N·m, not a field tightening specification. High friction gives inadequate preload at the target torque, while low friction can overstrain the bolt. Untracked relaxation also means initial compliance does not prove sustained joint contact throughout service.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設示意T=KdF，K=0.2、d=0.024 m、F=100 kN，T=480 N·m；非現場鎖付規格。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed T=KdF with K=0.2, d=0.024 m and F=100 kN, T=480 N·m, not a field tightening specification.
units.verify: 由合格連接件試驗建立摩擦與預力關係，檢查潤滑狀態、批號及量測方法；現場依核准程序查核，必要時用直接或間接張力證據，不能照教學扭矩自行鎖付。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：摩擦偏大時扭矩達標但預力不足，偏小時又可能過度拉伸；若接縫後續鬆弛未被追蹤，初始合格紀錄也不能證明長期接觸狀態。~Establish friction-preload behavior through qualified connector testing with lubrication, batch and measurement records; field verification follows approved procedures and appropriate tension evidence, never the teaching torque as an instruction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: High friction gives inadequate preload at the target torque, while low friction can overstrain the bolt. Untracked relaxation also means initial compliance does not prove sustained joint contact throughout service.
units.failure: 摩擦偏大時扭矩達標但預力不足，偏小時又可能過度拉伸；若接縫後續鬆弛未被追蹤，初始合格紀錄也不能證明長期接觸狀態。~High friction gives inadequate preload at the target torque, while low friction can overstrain the bolt. Untracked relaxation also means initial compliance does not prove sustained joint contact throughout service.
units.misconception: 螺栓扭矩相同就保證實際預力相同，不受摩擦影響。~Equal bolt torque guarantees equal preload regardless of friction conditions.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄螺栓預力與摩擦離散的資料來源與適用條件。由合格連接件試驗建立摩擦與預力關係，檢查潤滑狀態、批號及量測方法；現場依核准程序查核，必要時用直接或間接張力證據，不能照教學扭矩自行鎖付。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for bolt preload and friction scatter. Establish friction-preload behavior through qualified connector testing with lubrication, batch and measurement records; field verification follows approved procedures and appropriate tension evidence, never the teaching torque as an instruction.

units.anchor: 轉動剛度與非線性~Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity
units.title: 轉動剛度與非線性~Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity
units.mechanism: 接縫彎矩對轉角曲線通常隨接觸區縮小和螺栓啟動而改變斜率，不是一個固定彈簧。全環模型若使用等效剛度，必須說明載重範圍和軸力條件，避免把初始斜率外推到大轉角。 假設某區間ΔM=20 kN·m、Δθ=0.002 rad，割線增量剛度10 MN·m/rad；非全曲線常數。 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。~Moment-rotation behavior changes as contact shrinks and bolts engage, rather than remaining one constant spring. Equivalent ring-model stiffness therefore needs a stated moment range and axial force, preventing initial stiffness from being extrapolated to large rotation. For assumed ΔM=20 kN·m and Δθ=0.002 rad, incremental secant stiffness is 10 MN·m/rad, not a constant for the entire curve. A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設某區間ΔM=20 kN·m、Δθ=0.002 rad，割線增量剛度10 MN·m/rad；非全曲線常數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed ΔM=20 kN·m and Δθ=0.002 rad, incremental secant stiffness is 10 MN·m/rad, not a constant for the entire curve.
units.verify: 在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。~Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.
units.failure: 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。~A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.
units.misconception: 接縫初始轉動剛度可以直接套用到任何大轉角。~Initial joint rotational stiffness applies directly at any large rotation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄轉動剛度與非線性的資料來源與適用條件。在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rotational stiffness and nonlinearity. Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model.

units.anchor: 接縫轉角與止水張開~Joint rotation and seal opening
units.title: 接縫轉角與止水張開~Joint rotation and seal opening
units.mechanism: 結構接縫的轉角會在止水線位置放大或減少縫寬，水密檢核需要知道止水墊距轉動中心的距離。只看接縫中心位移可能漏掉邊緣張開，結構與防水模型必須使用相同幾何。 假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。 若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。~Joint rotation changes opening at the sealing line according to distance from the rotation center. Center displacement can miss edge opening, requiring structural and waterproofing models to share the same geometry and sign convention. Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening. An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening.
units.verify: 同時量測接縫中心和邊緣位移，與止水墊試驗包絡對照；結構及防水工程師確認轉角方向、偏心與錯台組合，不能用不同基準的兩份報告各自宣布合格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。~Measure center and edge movement together and compare the gasket test envelope; structural and waterproofing engineers align rotation, eccentricity and offset combinations rather than separately approving reports with inconsistent geometry. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket.
units.failure: 若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。~An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket.
units.misconception: 接縫中心平均縫寬就是止水線實際承受的最大張開。~Mean gap at the joint center equals maximum actual opening at the sealing line.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄接縫轉角與止水張開的資料來源與適用條件。同時量測接縫中心和邊緣位移，與止水墊試驗包絡對照；結構及防水工程師確認轉角方向、偏心與錯台組合，不能用不同基準的兩份報告各自宣布合格。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint rotation and seal opening. Measure center and edge movement together and compare the gasket test envelope; structural and waterproofing engineers align rotation, eccentricity and offset combinations rather than separately approving reports with inconsistent geometry.

units.anchor: 錯縫排列與環間傳力~Staggered joints and ring interaction
units.title: 錯縫排列與環間傳力~Staggered joints and ring interaction
units.mechanism: 相鄰環錯開縱向接縫可改變彎矩與剪力傳遞，但效果取決於環間接觸、連接件與摩擦。不能把錯縫自動等同完整連續襯砌，施工階段尚未形成同樣約束時尤其需要分開分析。 假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。 把環間完全黏結會高估荷載重分配能力，若某環接觸不足，原先假定的旁路傳力可能消失；單環試驗又不能直接證明多環錯縫效果。~Staggering longitudinal joints changes bending and shear transfer through adjacent rings, depending on contact, connectors and friction. It does not automatically create a monolithic lining, especially before construction-stage restraints are established. Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved. Perfect inter-ring bonding overstates redistribution. Inadequate contact can remove an assumed alternate load path, while a single-ring test cannot directly demonstrate the effects of staggered multiring interaction in service.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved.
units.verify: 以多環模型或代表性試驗檢查環間滑移和連接件受力，核對實際錯縫角度及施工順序；分析者需比較低摩擦和局部脫開情境，不能只採理想黏結模型。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把環間完全黏結會高估荷載重分配能力，若某環接觸不足，原先假定的旁路傳力可能消失；單環試驗又不能直接證明多環錯縫效果。~Use multiring analysis or representative tests to examine slip and connector force with actual stagger and sequence; compare low-friction and local separation cases rather than relying solely on ideal bonding. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Perfect inter-ring bonding overstates redistribution. Inadequate contact can remove an assumed alternate load path, while a single-ring test cannot directly demonstrate the effects of staggered multiring interaction in service.
units.failure: 把環間完全黏結會高估荷載重分配能力，若某環接觸不足，原先假定的旁路傳力可能消失；單環試驗又不能直接證明多環錯縫效果。~Perfect inter-ring bonding overstates redistribution. Inadequate contact can remove an assumed alternate load path, while a single-ring test cannot directly demonstrate the effects of staggered multiring interaction in service.
units.misconception: 只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。~Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄錯縫排列與環間傳力的資料來源與適用條件。以多環模型或代表性試驗檢查環間滑移和連接件受力，核對實際錯縫角度及施工順序；分析者需比較低摩擦和局部脫開情境，不能只採理想黏結模型。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for staggered joints and ring interaction. Use multiring analysis or representative tests to examine slip and connector force with actual stagger and sequence; compare low-friction and local separation cases rather than relying solely on ideal bonding.

units.anchor: 循環載重與鬆弛~Cyclic loading and relaxation
units.title: 循環載重與鬆弛~Cyclic loading and relaxation
units.mechanism: 列車、溫度或水壓變動使接縫反覆變形，螺栓預力可能鬆弛且接觸面磨耗。循環次數只有配合幅值、平均力和連接細節才有疲勞意義，不能單憑次數推斷必然破壞。 假設每日100次代表循環、30年、365日/年，總次數1,095,000；不含不同幅值合併。 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。~Traffic, thermal and water-pressure cycles repeatedly deform joints, potentially relaxing preload and wearing contacts. Cycle count has fatigue meaning only alongside amplitude, mean force and connector detail, not as a standalone failure prediction. Assume 100 representative cycles per day for 30 years at 365 days/year; total count is 1095000, without combining different amplitude ranges. Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每日100次代表循環、30年、365日/年，總次數1,095,000；不含不同幅值合併。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 100 representative cycles per day for 30 years at 365 days/year; total count is 1095000, without combining different amplitude ranges.
units.verify: 量測代表載重譜和螺栓力或接縫開合，區分服務循環與施工一次性載重；疲勞檢核使用適用細節與試驗資料，維護計畫保留預力或位移基線以識別長期改變。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。~Measure representative spectra and bolt force or joint opening, separating service cycles from one-time construction loads; use appropriate detail and test evidence for fatigue and retain preload or movement baselines for long-term comparison. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.
units.failure: 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。~Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.
units.misconception: 疲勞循環次數足夠多就能不看幅值直接決定剩餘壽命。~A large cycle count determines remaining fatigue life without considering amplitudes.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄循環載重與鬆弛的資料來源與適用條件。量測代表載重譜和螺栓力或接縫開合，區分服務循環與施工一次性載重；疲勞檢核使用適用細節與試驗資料，維護計畫保留預力或位移基線以識別長期改變。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cyclic loading and relaxation. Measure representative spectra and bolt force or joint opening, separating service cycles from one-time construction loads; use appropriate detail and test evidence for fatigue and retain preload or movement baselines for long-term comparison.

units.anchor: 局部裂縫與連接錨定~Local cracks and connector anchorage
units.title: 局部裂縫與連接錨定~Local cracks and connector anchorage
units.mechanism: 螺栓或榫鍵把力集中輸入環片，周邊混凝土需要足夠錨定與劈裂控制。整體接縫力小不代表局部安全，孔位、公差和缺角會改變有效受力區，須結合構造細節檢查。 假設錨定區合力120 kN、有效受力面0.02 m²，名義應力6 MPa；不是混凝土局部承載驗算全式。 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。~Bolts and keys introduce concentrated forces requiring adequate anchorage and splitting control. Modest global joint force does not ensure local safety; hole location, tolerances and chips change the effective resisting region and must be checked with detailing. Assumed anchorage force 120 kN over effective area 0.02 m² gives nominal stress 6 MPa, not a complete local concrete-capacity check. Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設錨定區合力120 kN、有效受力面0.02 m²，名義應力6 MPa；不是混凝土局部承載驗算全式。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed anchorage force 120 kN over effective area 0.02 m² gives nominal stress 6 MPa, not a complete local concrete-capacity check.
units.verify: 核對連接件位置、配筋及混凝土缺陷，利用核准試驗或分析檢查拔出、劈裂和局部壓碎；損傷照片須能追到環片及接縫位置，由結構工程師決定可否修復使用。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。~Check connector location, reinforcement and defects and assess pullout, splitting and crushing through approved analysis or tests; trace damage photographs to segment and joint for structural review of repairability and use. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete.
units.failure: 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。~Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete.
units.misconception: 外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。~An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄局部裂縫與連接錨定的資料來源與適用條件。核對連接件位置、配筋及混凝土缺陷，利用核准試驗或分析檢查拔出、劈裂和局部壓碎；損傷照片須能追到環片及接縫位置，由結構工程師決定可否修復使用。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for local cracks and connector anchorage. Check connector location, reinforcement and defects and assess pullout, splitting and crushing through approved analysis or tests; trace damage photographs to segment and joint for structural review of repairability and use.

units.anchor: 足尺試驗與邊界~Full-scale tests and boundaries
units.title: 足尺試驗與邊界~Full-scale tests and boundaries
units.mechanism: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。足尺不代表所有邊界都正確，須區分試體變形、設備柔度與局部就位，才能用於模型校準。 假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。 設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。~Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. Full size does not guarantee correct boundaries; separate specimen deformation, machine compliance and seating before calibrating a model. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence. Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence.
units.verify: 使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。~Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis.
units.failure: 設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。~Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis.
units.misconception: 足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。~Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄足尺試驗與邊界的資料來源與適用條件。使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for full-scale tests and boundaries. Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual.

units.anchor: 接縫驗證與工程簽認~Joint verification and engineering signoff
units.title: 接縫驗證與工程簽認~Joint verification and engineering signoff
units.mechanism: 接縫驗收需要連結結構、水密與組裝幾何，而不是三份互不對照的合格表。交接保存最不利組合、試驗覆蓋與剩餘假設，確保營運期檢查知道哪些裂縫或開合屬模型失效訊號。 假設10種設計組合中8種經直接試驗、2種靠分析外推，直接覆蓋80%；外推2種需明列限制。 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。~Joint acceptance links structural, waterproofing and assembly evidence rather than three unrelated pass sheets. Handover retains adverse combinations, test coverage and assumptions so operational inspections recognize signs invalidating the model. If 8 of an assumed 10 design combinations have direct testing and 2 rely on analysis, direct coverage is 80%; limits of the other 2 remain explicit. Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10種設計組合中8種經直接試驗、2種靠分析外推，直接覆蓋80%；外推2種需明列限制。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 design combinations have direct testing and 2 rely on analysis, direct coverage is 80%; limits of the other 2 remain explicit.
units.verify: 從一組最不利N-M與錯台條件追查到試驗、產品和現地紀錄，檢查各自坐標及版本；結構、防水及品質負責人共同確認外推依據，不以整體通過率替代單一關鍵組合的審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。~Trace one adverse N-M-offset combination through tests, products and field records with consistent coordinates and versions; structural, sealing and quality leads jointly approve extrapolation rather than using an overall pass rate to waive a critical combination. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed.
units.failure: 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。~Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed.
units.misconception: 結構和水密報告各自通過就無須統一張開幾何定義。~Separate structural and sealing approvals eliminate the need for a common opening definition.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄接縫驗證與工程簽認的資料來源與適用條件。從一組最不利N-M與錯台條件追查到試驗、產品和現地紀錄，檢查各自坐標及版本；結構、防水及品質負責人共同確認外推依據，不以整體通過率替代單一關鍵組合的審查。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint verification and engineering signoff. Trace one adverse N-M-offset combination through tests, products and field records with consistent coordinates and versions; structural, sealing and quality leads jointly approve extrapolation rather than using an overall pass rate to waive a critical combination.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry.

教學量化備忘：假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold.
教學量化備忘：假設示意T=KdF，K=0.2、d=0.024 m、F=100 kN，T=480 N·m；非現場鎖付規格。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed T=KdF with K=0.2, d=0.024 m and F=100 kN, T=480 N·m, not a field tightening specification.

教學量化備忘：假設某區間ΔM=20 kN·m、Δθ=0.002 rad，割線增量剛度10 MN·m/rad；非全曲線常數。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed ΔM=20 kN·m and Δθ=0.002 rad, incremental secant stiffness is 10 MN·m/rad, not a constant for the entire curve.

教學量化備忘：假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening.

教學量化備忘：假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved.
